commits.summary: Record the setup jobs' results for the blind-caller and PR-verification brief
commits.body:
Both setup jobs passed. 20261127-032247-setup-replay-the-p-q-r-n-and-m-public-ob replayed every P, Q, R, N and M historical observation in fresh JVMs at 5c57e715acb8 and found each audit byte-identical to its committed audit.json. 20261127-032259-setup-run-parquet-3638-s-upstream-parque ran Parquet #3638's whole parquet-column and parquet-hadoop suites (138 classes) on the original 113-entry graphs: fix-on-fix and parent-on-parent fail the same 24 tests, fix-on-parent adds exactly the two landed TestDictionary tests, and the record lists the shared failures and 24 aborts by cause (version skew against 1.18.2, the missing Brotli codec, default heap, no vectored IO in Hadoop 3.3.0).

One shared failure, TestParquetWriterError#testInSeparateProcess, came from the setup's launch: its child JVM inherited only the console launcher jar as java.class.path. The cache scripts now start the launcher from -cp; a capped probe shows the test passing on the fix graph and only the two landed tests failing on the parent. The record and its Setup Agent Notes are updated, with the results' commits (dc6fd6c8f17f, 2c45066adba0), which this line has not merged.
